worldcombat.skill.encore.summary: Calls for a repeat of the target’s last move, temporarily allowing only that move. For ordinary creatures and players, it locks the last successful attack method, such as melee or arrows.
worldcombat.skill.encore.use.0: Lock down a setup or boost the target just used
worldcombat.skill.encore.use.1: Break a combo rhythm so it can only do the same thing
worldcombat.skill.encore.use.2: Pin a foe that just exposed an opening
worldcombat.skill.encore.description.0: The lock lasts %1$s and can name an attack from the last %2$s. Pokémon may use only the named move; ordinary creatures and players have damage from other attack methods blocked.
worldcombat.skill.encore.description.1: Calling range is %1$s blocks. The target still acts on its own; the echo restricts which attack methods it may use.
worldcombat.skill.encore.description.2: The call takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. The echo is a visible window; it fades when cured or when that move runs dry.
worldcombat.skill.encore.strict.0: Stern: a longer echo, but a shorter call and a slower, costlier cast.
worldcombat.skill.encore.strict.1: Light: a shorter echo, but a longer reach, a faster wind-up and a cheaper cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.encore.timing: Cast on a single enemy: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s, the cooldown %5$s from commit, and the current range %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.encore.preference.stri: On: repeat duration x1.3, call reach x0.8, +2 ticks wind-up, cooldown x1.15. Off (Light): repeat duration x0.8, reach x1.15, -1 tick wind-up, cooldown x0.85. Trade a longer loop for a closer, slower call or the reverse.
worldcombat.skill.encore.preference.ai.m: The partner only names a target that acted within this window; smaller keeps it to fresh actions, larger names older ones.
The partner considers a call only while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee, larger chases out.
worldcombat.skill.encore.preference.ai.l: When on, the partner will also leave its post to call.
world_combat.move.encore.text.fade: The move ran dry, the echo fades
